heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service.

items.question: Which headsets do you support?
items.answer: We build for Oculus, Google VR and mixed reality devices, depending on your audience.

items.question: How do you prevent motion sickness?
items.answer: We use comfort-focused movement, stable frame rates and careful scene design.

items.question: Can VR content be reused on mobile?
items.answer: In many cases, yes. Shared assets can power lighter mobile experiences.

items.question: How long does virtual reality app development take?
items.answer: A focused app usually takes 8 to 12 weeks, while feature-rich apps with custom backends take 4 to 8 months.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide maintenance, updates, monitoring and new feature development after launch.
